renderer_limitation: The installed grouped_bar renderer requires y_min = 0 and rejects negative values; the custom SVG preserves the paper Completion change of -2.80 percentage points.
title: Similar Macro gain, different axis profiles
description: A measured comparison separates Macro relative gain from axis-level percentage-point changes. Macro relative gain is 10.93% locally and 10.78% in the paper. Local versus paper changes are Call 4.93 versus 1.40, Completion 7.04 versus -2.80, Slot 7.01 versus 27.80, and Relevance 5.69 versus 8.70 percentage points. The conditions use different checkpoints, preference data, and judge backends and are not one common effect estimate.
